title: Tooltip, picker-note and layout-verdict text renders below the card's own 12 px type floor
claim: Across the 900-cell grid, 78 cells render text below 12 px, the smallest step of the card's --hpo-text scale and the floor its other small text keeps with max(12px, ...): the chart tooltip at 10.92 px and its shared-step note at 9.28 px in the phone-width dialog, the shared-step note at 10.95 px at 768/1280 px, the entity picker's note (.sp-note) at 11.2 px and the layout verdict at 11.9 px at every viewport.
mechanism: These rules size type as a bare em multiple of an already reduced parent (dialog.expanded .tooltip { font-size: 0.78em } under @media (max-width: 600px), .tooltip .tt-shared { font-size: 0.85em }, .sp-note and .layout-verdict.match at 0.8/0.85 em), without the max(12px, ...) guard the stylesheet applies in 13 other places, so the product falls under the scale's floor.

evidence.machine: box B10 (4 vCPU, Linux, Chromium 1243 via playwright 1.63.0, Node 22)
evidence.contention_note: ran beside the seat's own grid runs; a count, contention-immune
evidence.unit: count of cells with any visible HTML text run whose computed font-size < 12 px

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:cardStyleBlock (.tooltip, .tooltip .tt-shared, dialog.expanded .tooltip, .sp-note, .layout-verdict rules) as Chromium computes them
metric_definition: cells (state x viewport x theme x language) in which a visible HTML element with its own text has computed font-size below 11.995 px
phenomenon_property: No text the card renders, in any state, viewport or language, is smaller than the --hpo-text-xs floor (12 px).

null_control.value: 0 of 822 cells outside these six states
null_control.note: the other 44 states, all viewports, both themes, three languages render no text under 12 px: the floor holds wherever a max(12px, ...) guard or a token sets the size

proposed_fix_scope: Give the five rules the stylesheet's own max(12px, ...) guard or a --hpo-text token; keep the phone tooltip inside its chart by width, not by shrinking type.
criteria_statement: D4-criteria 'look professional' (D4.M3 typography consistency); P9's unfloored mechanism applied to type
